beats.text: Five books that will quietly break your heart — in the best possible way.
One. Wuthering Heights — Brontë. A love so fierce it ruins everyone it touches.
Two. The Great Gatsby — Fitzgerald. A man in love with a dream that was never real.
Three. A Tale of Two Cities — Dickens. A sacrifice you'll be thinking about for days.
Four. Tess of the d'Urbervilles — Hardy. A good woman, crushed by everyone else's cruelty.
Five. The Metamorphosis — Kafka. The quiet heartbreak of being slowly unloved.
Some books entertain. These ones stay. Full retellings are on the channel.

source_note: Full retellings of each are on ReadLark.
